the functional impact of chemokine SDF-1/CXCR4 on two TTX-resistant sodium channels in DRG neurons and may provide a new target to treat chronic pain.

the SDF-1/CXCR4 axis plays a role in the modulation of TTX-resistant sodium currents in small DRG neurons.
